title: Paband agar ghazi
body:
paband agar ghazi alamdar na hota
zainab ka khula sar sare bazaar na hota
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko ladne ki agar hoti ijazat
phir ghazi sakina se sharam saar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte na wazoo khoon se hussain ibne ali bhi
masoom jo pani ka talab gaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati na kabhi aag mein haye saani e zahra
jalte huwe qaimon mein jo bemaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsar e sakina pe tamache bhi na lagte
is tarha yateemi ka bhi izhaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko ghash aata na raahon mein kabhi yun
zainab teri chadar ka jo takraar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein agar sar ko na shabbir katate
yun deen e mohamed ka bhi parchaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha sar e zindan na kabhi marti sakina
baba se sakina ko agar pyar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
